page: Amazon Web Services r7gd.16xlarge is a memory-optimized instance powered by AWS Graviton processors. Built on the ARMv8 architecture using Neoverse-V1 cores, this instance features 64 dedicated physical cores running at 2.6 GHz with a single thread per core. It is equipped with 512.0 GB of memory, translating to 8.0 GB of RAM per core. Storage is bundled as 3800 GB of local NVMe SSD instance store, and the network interface provides a baseline bandwidth of 30 Gbps.

Benchmark data reveals strong multi-core and memory subsystem performance. The instance achieved a top-tier rating in the Geekbench multi-core test and software compilation with Clang. Passmark memory scores are also in the top tier, supported by strong memory bandwidth results, including 6200.09 GB/sec for cached small-block reads and 253.52 GB/sec for uncached large-block reads. Database operations and Redis SET operations both demonstrated strong performance, with Redis reaching 101.36 million operations per second.

While multi-core and memory-bound operations excel, single-core performance is average, as shown by stress-ng and Geekbench single-core benchmarks. Additionally, LLM text generation for small models is rated as poor, though medium-model text generation is strong. Given the high memory density, dedicated ARM cores, and fast local NVMe storage, this instance is highly cost-efficient for memory-intensive workloads. It is well-suited for large-scale databases, in-memory caching systems like Redis, software compilation, and high-throughput web serving.
